title: Past Simple
en:
Finished actions at a finished time: I visited the plant last week. We went to Almaty in May.

Regular verbs: -ed (work → worked, stop → stopped, study → studied). Many common verbs are irregular: go → went, make → made, send → sent, write → wrote.

Negative and questions: didn't / did + infinitive: I didn't send it. Did you see the email?

Time words: yesterday, last week, in 2020, two days ago.
ru: Законченное действие в прошлом с указанием времени (yesterday, last week, ago). Правильные глаголы + -ed, неправильные — 2-я форма. В вопросах и отрицаниях — did / didn't + начальная форма.

boss.situation: Write 5 sentences about your last working week: what you did, who you met, what you didn't finish.
samples: Last week I tested three controls.
On Tuesday I met the auditors from head office.
I sent the report to my manager on Thursday.
We had a long meeting about risks.
I didn't finish the presentation, so I'll do it on Monday.
